why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Download the LETSTOP app Install LETSTOP from Google Play or the App Store , the two download options on the project's homepage .
2 Step 2 : Create your account Open the app and register an account. The homepage says this takes seconds. The install and setup guide covers the first-run steps.
3 Step 3 : Drive without touching your phone Start trips with the app running and keep your hands off the phone. The app scores each drive, and drives below a certain distance do not earn credits.
4 Step 4 : Collect credits Credits are added automatically for safe driving and are shared out to active drivers every hour. Your rewards guide explains the factors behind your share.
5 Step 5 : Convert credits to STOP tokens When you want tokens, convert credits in the app. The first conversion guide and the wallet guide describe converting and managing STOP.
